row: Dr. Justin Cough is a practicing chiropractor and founder of Oviedo Chiropractic. As a graduate of Palmer College of Chiropractic in Port Orange, FL, Dr. Cough is dedicated to serving the community through the education and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders. Dr. Cough takes pride in utilizing the most beneficial, evidence-based treatment strategies, tailored for each patient treated at Oviedo Chiropractic.
